_meta.scope: Concise signification guidance for the 13 previously uncovered Vargas. This is interpretive reference data, not deterministic prediction.

D2.name: Hora
D2.interpretation: Use with the D1 financial picture to assess resource support, accumulation capacity and the solar/lunar quality of material expression.

D3.name: Drekkana
D3.interpretation: Used as a supplementary chart for siblings, personal initiative, courage, communication effort and practical enterprise.

D4.name: Chaturthamsha
D4.interpretation: Used as a supplementary indicator for fixed assets, residence, property matters, vehicles and the fortune associated with foundations.

D7.name: Saptamsha
D7.interpretation: Used with the fifth house and Jupiter to examine children, progeny themes, responsibility and continuity of lineage.

D12.name: Dvadashamsha
D12.interpretation: Used for parental influences, inherited patterns, ancestry and the continuity of family traits.

D16.name: Shodashamsha
D16.interpretation: Used for comforts, vehicles, domestic conveniences and the capacity to enjoy or maintain material ease.

D20.name: Vimshamsha
D20.interpretation: Used for spiritual discipline, worship, mantra practice, devotion and the practical expression of religious inclination.

D24.name: Chaturvimshamsha
D24.interpretation: Used for formal learning, scholarship, knowledge acquisition, teachers and sustained intellectual development.

D27.name: Bhamsha
D27.interpretation: Used as a supplementary strength chart for subtle capacities, vulnerabilities, endurance and the way planetary qualities manifest under pressure.

D30.name: Trimshamsha
D30.interpretation: Used for difficult tendencies, vulnerabilities and adverse circumstances; it should never be read in isolation as a deterministic harm indicator.

D40.name: Khavedamsha
D40.interpretation: Used in some Parashari traditions for finer ancestral and maternal-line indications and subtle auspicious/inauspicious influences.

D45.name: Akshavedamsha
D45.interpretation: Used in finer divisional analysis for character, inherited paternal-line themes and deeper dharmic tendencies.

D60.name: Shashtiamsha
D60.interpretation: A highly sensitive divisional chart traditionally used for subtle karmic/ancestral indications. Birth-time accuracy is critical because a small time error can change the D60.
